title: Qwen3-Coder-Next Q4_K_M GGUF on a 64GB MacBook (llama.cpp)
slug_note: The petems 64GB recipe: official Q4_K_M GGUF (48.4GB) at a capped 64K context; speeds are planning ranges, so untested.

variation.quant_detail: Official Q4_K_M export, four shards totaling 48.4GB
variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next-GGUF resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-27 test

engine.config: llama-server on Metal per the petems 64GB recipe; context capped at 64K because the default 256K OOMs instantly

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): 48.5 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772), --ctx-size 65536). Earlier estimate: petems plans ~45GB RAM for Q4_K_M at 64K context; the official shards total 48.4GB, so keep mmap on and budget ~52GB.

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (633-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772), --ctx-size 65536

caveats: The guide expects 15-25 tok/s on a 64GB Mac at 64K context, but that is a planning range, not a measurement; the row stays untested.
The guide's ~45GB RAM figure is below the official Q4_K_M shard total of 48.4GB; budget ~52GB with KV headroom.
If the box swaps, the guide's order is: reduce ctx to 16K, then GPU layers, then close apps.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): `llama-server -hf Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next-GGUF:Q4_K_M --ctx-size 65536 --n-gpu-layers 99 --flash-attn on --jinja` — llama.cpp build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772); server ready 60 s after start with the OS file cache dropped; the functional check passed; MemAvailable dropped 48.5 GiB (weights + KV at --ctx-size 65536).
